description.value: Art Alchemy Studio is an art gallery and working studio space in Courtenay on Vancouver Island, associated with local artist Sharon Lalonde who works in the Comox Valley. The studio participates in community arts events and exhibitions in the region. A touring cyclist passing through Courtenay's arts district may find it a worthwhile stop for locally created visual art.
